record.question:
State whether the following are 'True' or 'False'.
(a) The term 'family' for the purpose of CCS (Medical Attendance) Rules include widowed sisters.
(b) Grant of advances is admissible to Government servants and the members of their families as an out-patient in the case of TB/Cancer.
(c) No fees should be charged by the Medical Officer in receipt of a non-practising allowances for the professional services rendered to the Government servants and members of their families.
(d) Blood transfusion charges for the supply of blood to patients in hospitals are not refundable.
(e) Fees paid to specialist by Government servants for testing their eyesight for glasses at Government hospitals once every three years cannot be reimbursed.
